title: Northgate — Free Bootstrap 6 School Website Template
excerpt: A free two-page Bootstrap 6 school and college template — programmes, an admissions stepper, key dates, staff and a visit-request form.
yoastTitle: Northgate — Free Bootstrap 6 School Website Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 school website template with programme cards, a four-step admissions stepper, key dates, staff profiles and a visit form using Combobox, Datepicker and Chip input.
intro: Northgate is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 website template for schools, colleges and academies. It pairs a full school homepage — programmes, admissions, school life, staff, news and contact — with a programme detail page, covering the pages a prospective parent actually reads before booking a visit.
note: The admissions journey is built on Bootstrap 6's new Stepper component, and the visit-request form combines a Combobox entry-point picker, the new Datepicker and a Chip input for topics of interest. None of those exist in Bootstrap 5.
summary: Northgate is a free, premium two-page Bootstrap 6 template for schools, colleges and academies. The homepage covers programmes with a Combobox filter, a four-step admissions Stepper, an accordion FAQ, key dates, tabbed school life, staff profiles, news and a visit-request form. The programme page adds prose typography, entry requirements and a sticky enquiry rail. ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step, full light and dark mode.
features: Two pages — school homepage and a programme detail page
Four-step admissions journey built on the new Stepper component
Programme cards with a searchable Combobox stage filter
Key dates list, tabbed school life section and staff profiles
Visit-request form with Combobox entry point, Datepicker and Chip input interests
Accordion FAQ on native <details> — exclusive groups, zero JavaScript
Utility bar for parent portal and staff login links
ScrollSpy navigation offset for the sticky header
Retheme the whole site by changing a single --brand token
Full dark mode via data-bs-theme, remembered across visits
ESM-only vanilla JavaScript — no jQuery, no bundler, no build step
